summary: Iteration 41 targeted retest of the Bellam→jaggery translation gate PASSED. All 7 spec cases from the review request pass. Bonus: full TestChange3_FreeImagePicker suite from iteration 40 (12 tests) now passes end-to-end — the previously-failing test_2_regional_translation[Bellam-jaggery] is fixed. Fix in /app/backend/routes/products_master_images.py correctly makes vernacular terms in _TRANSLATIONS always search the English translation first (Bellam→jaggery, Uddi/Minap pappu→urad dal, Kandi pappu→toor dal, Senaga pappu→chana dal). Non-vernacular 'Sugar' passes through unchanged with count=10. Gibberish 'nonexistgibberish123' correctly returns 404. Backend only — frontend skipped per request.
action_items: Nothing further — translation gate fix verified. Iteration 40 minor issue is now RESOLVED.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix approach (translate-first, raw-fallback on 0 hits) is correct and future-proof for other Openverse-indexed vernacular terms.
Cache-clearing of free_imgs::* keys was necessary and executed — retest hit fresh code path (verified by response containing resolved_query='jaggery' for q='Bellam').
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 40's outstanding minor issue is now fixed and covered by BOTH /app/backend/tests/test_iteration41.py (targeted) and /app/backend/tests/test_iteration40.py::TestChange3_FreeImagePicker::test_2_regional_translation. Verified spec responses via direct curl-equivalent Python script — Bellam→jaggery(count=10), Uddi/Minap pappu→urad dal(10), Kandi pappu→toor dal(10), Senaga pappu→chana dal(10), Sugar→Sugar(10), gibberish→404.
rca_of_issue: Original bug (iter 40): translation was gated on `len(primary) < 3 and translation`, which never fired for 'Bellam' because Openverse returned 10 raw hits for the Telugu word. Fix in products_master_images.py inverted the gate for KNOWN _TRANSLATIONS keys: always search the English translation first, only fall back to raw if translation returns 0 hits. Verification: q='Bellam' now returns resolved_query='jaggery' count=10, matching spec.
